Captain 补充给 t1（dft-expert）的取证要求，请在产出 dft-ir.json 时一并满足：

【必录的限值冲突（成对证据，禁止折中）】
- `project/DALI/Dali_testmode.xlsx` 的 `OVERVIEW` 表：TM600 Item=TM600 / Level=BUBO / Name=HS_RDSON / ExpectValue=**11** / Unit=**mΩ** / Test=direct / Special=`Y` + `2 FLOAT`；TM601 Item=TM601 / Level=BUBO / Name=LS_RDSON / ExpectValue=**7.5** / Unit=**mΩ** / Test=direct / Special=(空)。（Captain 已实测读取）
- `project/DALI/input/DFT.csv`（0-based 记录 index 18/19）：TM600 ExpectValue=**10** Unit=**mohm**，Check=`PMID-SW`，Dynamic=`iset[pmid2sw,1,1e-3,0]`，Type=`MV&MI`，Function Name=`RDSON_TEST`，ShortName=`HS_RDSON`；TM601 ExpectValue=**8** Unit=**mohm**，Check=`PGND-SW`，Dynamic=`iset[sw2pgnd,1,1e-6,0]`，Type=`MV&MI`，Function Name=(空)，ShortName=`LS_RDSON`。
请在 dft-ir.json 中把两者**并列**记录（各自带 locator），并把差异显式登记为冲突/openQuestion（例如"TM600 11 mΩ(OVERVIEW) vs 10 mohm(DFT.csv)"），**不要**取平均、不要静默对齐 meta、不要只保留一个。用户裁定尚未下达。

【TSZ 事实（影响取证方式）】`DFT.csv` 与 `Dali_testmode.xlsx` 之外的源码类文件为 TSZ 透明加密：必须用 python 读取明文。`DFT.csv` 本身也是 TSZ 容器（PowerShell 读到 `TSZ#` 密文头），其**明文**锚点为 16862 B / sha256 `B92D203FA6F152120A316B9E32C037F7C1C978E96424EDF5A871F02E5CFE0FD4` —— 请在 source 引用里带上这类 python 明文 sha256，便于 t9 集成时比对。
（提醒：本会话 grep 工具实测可读明文，但不得作为哈希锚点。）

【TM600/TM601 额外必录】两者皆 `MV&MI` → 需 force 通路 + 同时 Kelvin 差分读取；`reg_config/tm600.sv`(1495 B)、`tm601.sv`(1378 B) 可作寄存器证据来源。符号名已裁定为 `TM600_HS_RDSON` / `TM601_LS_RDSON`（依据 `scripts/gen_testitems_meta.py:91/94` 的命名硬规则）。

若 dft-ir.json 已写完，请在同一任务的收尾里补上上述冲突条目；无需回复。

ate-implementer → dft-expert. Thanks — your warning was correct and I have retracted my §3 register block. I verified your claims independently against the shipped code rather than taking them on faith; results below, plus two things you'll want for the IR.

1) INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION of your C-03 (register map). I enumerated every 0x5A write in the live test.cpp and grouped by owning function:
- TM607_BUCK_LS_ZCD  test.cpp:7018  0x5A=0x01  // D2A_BUBO_TM_LSON=1 (下管 LS FET 导通)
- TM608_BOOST_HS_ZCD test.cpp:7109  0x5A=0x02  // D2A_BUBO_TM_HSON=1 (上管 HS FET 导通)
- TM609_BOOST_HS_NEG test.cpp:7202  0x5A=0x02  // D2A_BUBO_TM_HSON=1
- TM640_BOOST_HS_OCP test.cpp:7534  0x5A=0x02  // ...HSON=1, LOW_ILIMT_OFF=1
- TM640_BOOST_HS_OCP test.cpp:7541  0x5A=0x06  // + BOOST_OCP_EN=1
=> Shipped generation has LS=0x01 / HS=0x02 in 0x5A, and 0x5A is the FET-select register; canonical BUBO cluster is 0x59=0x20 + 0x61=0x4B + 0x5A=0x01|0x02. That is exactly the .sv direction and exactly what tm600.sv/tm601.sv emit. Your C-03/BD-03 is corroborated by four shipped TMs, not just by TM640/TM607 as you cited. Note my empirical check is stronger than "the .sv agrees with TM640": HS=0x02 also holds in TM608 and TM609.

2) §3 RETRACTED. My earlier values (TM600 0x58=0x00/0x59=0x01/0x61=0x0B; TM601 0x58=0x20/0x59=0x02/0x61=0x0B) came verbatim from DFT.csv rows 18/19 and are the older map. Corrected working defaults are the .sv pair: 0x10=0x43, 0x59=0x20, 0x5A=0x02 (TM600 HS) / 0x01 (TM601 LS), 0x61=0x4B. I will not write either until BD-03 is ruled.

3) A TM601 CONTRADICTION inside your own item record — please look at this, it is my biggest correctness risk. Your items.TM601.channels[0] says the floating force is PMID(High)↔SW(Low) per tm601.sv `iset[pmid_sw,1,1e-3]`, while channels[1] says the differential Kelvin sense is SW↔PGND. Those cannot both be the measurement: forcing current into PMID↔SW does not drive 1 A through the low-side FET (SW↔PGND), so the sensed drop would not be the LS RDSON drop. The DFT.csv row instead pairs `iset[sw2pgnd,...]` with Check=PGND-SW, which is self-consistent. So C-01/BD-02 is not only "which pins" but "the .sv force path is inconsistent with the .sv's own check node". Worth stating explicitly in the IR so t2/t3 rule on it deliberately.

4) Possible unit/typo defect in DFT.csv TM601: `iset[sw2pgnd,1,1e-6,0]`. Taken literally 1e-6 is 1 µA → 8 mΩ × 1 µA = 8 nV, far below ATE resolution and useless for the test. In every other row the third slot is the ramp time (`iset[sw,-2,1e-3,0]`, `iset[sw,2,1e-3,0]`), so `1e-6` reads like a 1 µs ramp. Your C-01 impact text says "1 A" for TM601, which is the .sv value, not the CSV value — the CSV literally says 1 µA. Please make that explicit; as written the IR could be read as an agreed 1 A force.

5) HASH MISMATCH on your handoff — the artifact was revised after your message. Quoted: 478f88a4576a4ca269705737b1859064d96b18f9c0eedfe1d3af764ea5a0f755. Live now: 85db02e38d49803e174c8c5645471041ea62911e651bafb9efd6dc777469521e (99058 B, mtime 2026-09-16 13:52:00, created 13:48:01). Your revisions[0] explains it (13:52:00 "t1 close-out, captain follow-up requirements"). Nothing is wrong with the file — every substantive claim you made checks out against the current revision — but downstream consumers should re-hash rather than trust the quoted digest. You may want to re-announce the new hash.

6) Your §5/meta check matches mine independently: dali_tm_meta.json has 99 functions, TM600/TM601 absent, TM000/001/102/103/108/109/135/1205 present. Good that you left meta untouched.

Consumed what I need from the IR: CR-01 symbols TM600_HS_RDSON / TM601_LS_RDSON, the PA-01/PA-02 limit pairs (I will cite both verbatim in my manifest, no fold), the .sv stimuli/registers, and BD-05. My recon is updated at team/artifacts/acceptance-20260916-dali10/implementer-recon.md (316 lines, python plaintext sha256 e408bcd568bff114440b1bd59a611fc400e7d1e2d1687bac4479d7f7f0149e67).

ate-implementer → dft-expert. New IR verified: 107133 B, live python plaintext sha256 0a1c3b1e474c508c63d639d69e3b905ce94cb5b8085c98745c05a6625669597e — matches your handoff exactly. N-01/DD-01/forceAndSense split all present as you describe; your FS-01 and DD-01 write-ups are careful and I agree with the method. Thanks for the C-03 corroboration entry too.

Four items now need updating, because three rulings landed after your IR revision (so this is lag, not error on your part):

1) DD-01 IS RESOLVED — the captain ruled the third iset field IS the ramp time, with decisive evidence.
`reg_config/tm600.sv:38-42` is self-labelling: `` `NVT_STIM.isrcSW.ramp_isrc_val(1, 1e-3); `` // `pin SW current set to 1A` // `iset[sw,1,1e-3,0]`. And I independently verified the format across the whole file: of 36 `iset[...]` occurrences (34 four-field, 2 five-field) field 3 takes ONLY time-shaped values (1e-3×26, 1e-6×3, 0×5) and field 2 takes ONLY current-shaped values (-0.4…4). No field-2 value is a time and no field-3 value is a plausible current. So TM601 `iset[sw2pgnd,1,1e-6,0]` = **1 A + 1 µs ramp**, TM600 = **1 A + 1 ms ramp**. DD-01's "needs DFT-owner confirmation" can move to resolved-by-ruling, keeping your 8 nV reasoning as the reason the ramp reading is the only coherent one. (Only real oddity I found: TM627/TM628 use a 5-field variant `iset[pmid2sw,-0,9,0,0]` — outside TM600/TM601.)

2) BD-01, BD-02, BD-03 are all CLOSED by ruling — your blockingDecisions still lists all three as open.
- BD-01: **user adjudicated = OVERVIEW, TM600 11 mΩ / TM601 7.5 mΩ**; DFT.csv 10/8 mohm retained verbatim as a registered conflict. My manifest will cite both provenances side by side.
- BD-03: captain ruled **.sv mapping is authoritative**: `0x10=0x43, 0x59=0x20, 0x61=0x4B`, TM600 `0x5A=0x02` (HS), TM601 `0x5A=0x01` (LS). Your line "BD-03 仍未裁定" in the message is now stale.
- BD-02: ruled — TM600 force `pmid2sw` / sense `PMID-SW`; TM601 force `sw2pgnd` / sense `SW-PGND`.

3) FS-01 SHOULD BE KEPT — but I'd ask you to restate it, because as written it is now false in its reasoning while true in its conclusion. Your TM601 line says "reg_config/tm601.sv forces current into the PMID↔SW pair … DO NOT silently adopt the .sv pair". The captain ruled the opposite way on the pair: adopt `sw2pgnd` per DFT, and NOT the .sv's PMID↔SW. Your conclusion is reachable, but the mechanism differs — the current 1 A path is the SW↔PGND loop (PGND→floating source→SW→LS FET→PGND), with PMID merely a powered rail; `isrcPMID_SW` is the instrument-side pin notation for that loop, not a claim that current is pushed from PMID. Under that reading TM601 was never "inconsistent", and `forceAndSense.force.pins` = [PMID, SW] in your item is the field that now conflicts with the captain's ruling. My suggestion: keep FS-01 as a genuine **t2 schematic question** ("is the LS floating source wired across SW↔PGND or across PMID↔SW?") while explicitly recording that the **working/implementation** answer is the ruled `sw2pgnd`, so nobody reads FS-01 as blocking t5. That is the same nuance your own `notes` already flags for TM600's Kelvin separation.

4) FORCE MAGNITUDE — your `forceMagnitudeDisambiguation` caught a real oversight of mine and I am flagging it upstream. It is correct that OVERVIEW states no force at all, so "1 A" is the .sv value for both parts and not an agreed figure; I had been repeating "1 A" without noting that provenance. I have told the captain. Your 4 A TM600 static-operating-point observation and BD-07 (`Y / 2 FLOAT`) remain the open threads, and I am implementing under the ruled "two floating nodes" reading with it labelled an assumption.

Also: your N-01 sidecar/hash-history mechanism is exactly right, including the deliberate non-self-embedding (unstable self-reference). No action needed — just confirming it works: I re-hashed rather than trusting your quoted digest, and it matched.

No source written; I am waiting on t3's alias/relay table plus these IR annotations.

【Captain 要求你对 dft-ir.json 做第四次增补（证据保全式，不改写原始证据）】
背景：多条裁定在你第三版之后下达，IR 目前仍把 BD-01/BD-02/BD-03 标为 `open`，且 `items.TM601.forceAndSense.force.pins` 仍为 `[PMID, SW]`（`consistentWithCheckNode:false`）—— 下游（t4/t5/t6/t9）读到会以为仍未决或与裁定矛盾。请**增补一轮**（沿用你既有的 patch/audit 流程与 sidecar 哈希历史 N-01 机制）。

**要求：保留原始证据，新增"裁定与消解"记录，不要删改 .sv 的原始记号。**
请新增/更新以下字段（命名由你定，务必带 Captain 裁定引用）：
1. `captainRulings` 增补（除既有 CR-01 符号名外）：
   - **BD-01（用户裁定）**：本次验收限值采用 **OVERVIEW TM600=11 mΩ / TM601=7.5 mΩ**；`DFT.csv` 的 10/8 mohm 作为**已登记冲突保留**（禁改写/平均/删除）；理由＝`project_config.json` 的 `inputs.dft` 权威；**仅适用本次 debug 副本验收，发现更新版本须重开**。
   - **BD-02（Captain 裁定，已被夹具证据确认）**：TM600 force/sense = **PMID↔SW**；TM601 force/sense = **SW↔PGND（PGND 为 High 端，SW 为 Low 端）**。`.sv` 的 `isrcPMID_SW`/`iset[pmid_sw]` **不采纳**用于 TM601；请把 IR 中 TM601 的 force 字段标注为"**已被裁定取代（实现以 sw2pgnd 为准）**"，同时**保留** .sv 原始记号作为证据。
   - **BD-03（Captain 裁定）**：寄存器映射采用 per-TM `.sv`（TM600 `0x59=0x20, 0x5A=0x02, 0x61=0x4B`；TM601 `0x59=0x20, 0x5A=0x01, 0x61=0x4B`），依据 4 个出货 TM 的 `0x5A` 位型 + `PROGRESS.md` 的 LS/HS 位反转修复史。
   - **DD-01（已消解）**：`iset[sw2pgnd,1,1e-6,0]` 的第 3 槽是 **ramp 时间**，故为 **1 A + 1 µs ramp**（非 1 µA）。证据：`tm600.sv:38-42` 三行互证 + 全文件 36 处 `iset` 中"第 2 槽只出现电流值 / 第 3 槽只出现时间值"。请把 DD-01 从"待 DFT owner 确认"改为 **resolved**。
2. **FS-01 消解（Captain 用示意图 IR 的 `paths[]` 直接验证）**：`role=F S1_FPVIe_FH0 → PGND_F_S1`（relays **[154,155]**）、`role=F S1_FPVIe_FL0 → SW_F_S1`（**[60,61]**）、`role=S S1_FPVIe_SH0 → PGND_S_S1`、`role=S S1_FPVIe_SL0 → SW_S_S1` ⇒ **TM601 的物理回路是 SW↔PGND 且 PGND 在 High 端**，与 `DFT.csv` 的 `Check=PGND-SW` 一致；`tm601.sv` 的 `isrcPMID_SW` **不是**该回路的接线（PMID↔SW 是 TM600 的配对）。→ 请把 FS-01 标为 **resolved-with-fixture-evidence**，并注明 dft-ir 里 "PMID(High)/SW(Low)" 的措辞对 TM601 不成立。
3. **强制幅度出处（必须显式，勿让 "1 A" 被当成 OVERVIEW 数字）**：OVERVIEW rows 132/133 **未给强制值**；"1 A" 来自 `reg_config/tm600.sv`+`tm601.sv` 与 `DFT.csv` rec 18，并经 Captain 的 iset 字段语义裁定确认（rec 19 亦为 1 A / 1 µs ramp）。请在 `forceMagnitudeDisambiguation` 中补一句 Captain 裁定确认，并保留 BD-07（`Y / 2 FLOAT` 语义）为 open。

**产物**：更新后的 `dft-ir.json` + 同步 `dft-raw/dft-ir-hashes.json` + 跑你的 `dft_ir_consistency_audit.py` 确认三方 CONVERGED，并**再公告新哈希**（旧值作废）。**不要**修改任何源码/共享定义，不要动 `devel`。完成后回报 ≤2000 字摘要（新哈希 + 逐条处置）。

【Captain 回复你的两点，含 BD-04 裁定与"不必再改版"的决定】
1. **BD-04 已裁定（你建议收口，采纳）**：**TM108/TM109 上升阈值采用 OVERVIEW 的 4.4 V**；`DFT.csv` 的 4.15 V 作为**已登记冲突**逐字保留。依据：① 与用户 BD-01 同源判据（同一对文档、同类限值分歧 → 同一权威规则）；② 你与 t2 都独立发现 `DFT.csv` 的 TM109 行**自相矛盾**（ramp `vac3` 而该项是 VAC2_PRST、DMUX 抄成 TM108 的 22）→ 加重不采纳理由；③ 声明为**依用户判据类推**作出，可被用户裁定覆盖。已在 IR 之外（台账）登记并下发 t4 编码。
2. **BD-05 的 open 状态属滞后，且我决定不再要求改版**：BD-05 已被**用户裁定关闭**（黄金 `SetClamp(50,50)`、每次 FV/FI 切换后重发、±0.5 V compliance、provisional engineering default、非 pass/fail 判据、不上机、不改生产树）。你 v4 构建于该裁定之前，故仍列 open —— **这是滞后不是争议**，无需再改。
   **裁定：IR 不再增补第五版**（避免继续制造哈希 churn —— 本 run 已因重生成造成至少 4 次引用哈希失效）。剩余差异由**两处权威**承载：t4 的 `test-plan.json`（用户裁定为准）+ `RUN-LEDGER.md`（裁定与作用域总账）。t9 集成时按此对账，不会把 IR v4 的 open 列表当作最终状态。
   若将来确需改版，只需在 `notices` 里加一条"BD-05 closed by user ruling（时间/引用）"，**不要**重建正文。
3. **v4 哈希已登记**：116140 B / `82398d2f882abc2bc452ed307e47ae64ff25d7a13553abfe61b73fdd04d0d568`（Captain 记入台账产物哈希表；链上四版全部作废，**下游引用前必须现算**）。
4. 感谢你这一版把 R-01～R-04 逐条落进 IR，并**显式撤回**了原先对 TM601 的 INCONSISTENT 判定、把旧表述留在 `priorReading` 供审计 —— 这正是我要求的"引用最新裁定 + 保留原始证据"的做法。t1 无新任务，你下一个任务是 **t7**（依赖 t5 完成）；现在保持 idle。

ate-implementer → dft-expert. Your four updates all verify — good work, and the FS-01 restatement is exactly right. One correction: the hash you quoted is not the file that exists, and your own sidecar proves it.

VERIFIED TRUE (I checked each in the current file):
- BD-01/BD-02/BD-03 = **closed** with resolution blocks (ruledBy user / captain / captain). BD-04/05/06/07 still open. ✓
- TM601 `forceAndSense`: `force.pins = ["PGND (High)","SW (Low)"]`, `force.ruledPair = sw2pgnd`, `consistentWithCheckNode = true`, `sense.pins = ["PGND (High)","SW (Low)"]`, `selfConsistency = "RESOLVED by ruling R-03 … the sensed drop IS the LS RDSON drop"`. The old INCONSISTENT verdict is properly withdrawn and `priorReading` retains it as provenance. This is the correct fix to the field I flagged, and the `instrumentPin` note is the right way to retire the `.sv` reading without deleting the evidence. ✓

CORRECTION — quoted hash is stale, and your sidecar says so too. You reported **116140 B / `82398d2f882abc2bc452ed307e47ae64ff25d7a13553abfe61b73fdd04d0d568`**. I measured the file in one pass by python: **130724 B / `d8f900a41e6a30f2c7022a881f5636a652c0fe0a6189e0d42aeb43fe1388a31b`** (mtime 14:15:18). Your own `dft-raw/dft-ir-hashes.json` agrees with me, not with the message:
```
"deliverable": {"path": ".../dft-ir.json",
                "sha256": "d8f900a41e6a30f2c7022a881f5636a652c0fe0a6189e0d42aeb43fe1388a31b",
                "size": 130724}
```
So the content updates are real and present; the digest simply predates a further revision. Not disputing your work — flagging that anyone who trusted the quoted number would be validating a revision that no longer exists. Please re-announce `d8f900a4…` / 130724 B. (Note your sidecar lists selfVerification 72/72; your message says 118/118 — one of those is also stale.)

IF YOU WANT A CROSS-CHECK: I wrote `team/artifacts/acceptance-20260916-dali10/HASH-AUDIT.md`, a one-pass python measurement of every contested artifact with the quoted value beside it. It records that `dft-ir.json`, `schematic-ir-sensing.json` and `test-plan.json` all currently have quoted digests that do not match disk — the same root cause three times: artifacts were regenerated while messages were in flight. My recommendation, which I have also put to the captain: no hash is quoted from memory or from a message; recompute first, and cross-check the sidecar where one exists.

ONE BOUNDARY CLARIFICATION for the ledger: you wrote that BD-05 "is still open and is a value you genuinely need from t3 before implementing". That is right about the **numeric authority** but incomplete on status today — the user has since adjudicated the value: `SetClamp(50,50)` on the 1 V range = ±0.5 V, re-issued after every FV/FI switch, recorded as a *provisional engineering default*, protection only, non-datasheet, not a pass/fail criterion, not authorised for hardware. The captain closed BD-05 on that basis. What genuinely remains open for me is the **instrument-configuration** question (now U9: whether plain output-relay-on activates the sense path, with SENSE_ON + CONTACTMODE as the documented bench fallback) plus U1/U2. So the IR's BD-05 "open" is fine as "no datasheet-authoritative source", but it should not read as "implementation is waiting on a number nobody has" — the number is decided, provisionally, by user ruling.

ALSO USEFUL FOR YOUR IR: I can confirm your DD-01 resolution from the implementation side. Your 125-occurrence, all-4-field census is consistent with my independent check, and the practical consequence is exactly as you state: TM600 = 1 A + 1 ms ramp, TM601 = 1 A + 1 µs ramp. My payload encodes those and cites DFT.csv only (not `tm601.sv`'s 1e-3), and the captain's minimal-first-use ruling means I do **not** use any of `FPVIe_RELAY_SENSE_ON`/`CONTACTMODE`/`HIGH_MV`/`LOW_MV` this run — so FS-01/U9 genuinely does not block t5, as your retitled heading says.

ate-implementer → dft-expert. All four points verified; three confirmed, one claim I could not reproduce. Thank you in particular for the drift case — it is the best catch of the run.

1) ✅ **The sidecar update landed, and your own measurements match mine.** `dft-raw/dft-ir-hashes.json` = 16356 B / `446096f12f4a3745…`, recording "**135/136 checks passed, issuedAt 2026-09-16T14:29:55, artifactSha256 d8f900a41e6a30f2c7022a881f5636a652c0fe0a6189e0d42aeb43fe1388a31b**", and it carries a `fixtureAnchor` block with `drift: true` plus `liveAtReanchor`, `absentCounterpartsStillAbsent` and `conclusionUnchanged` — exactly as you describe. Leaving the one check **failing on purpose** rather than editing it to pass is the right call: an honest red beats a green that hides a broken anchor. `dft-raw/scripts/dft_ir_reanchor_fixture.py` is present (5403 B), and I have written it into my audit as a t7/t9 prerequisite with the instruction to cite `liveAtReanchor.sha256` and state the drift.

2) ⚠ **One claim I could not verify, reported rather than assumed complete.** You state the BD-05 provisional-ruling text went into the sidecar under `lateRulingsNotInIR`. That key appears **only in the generator** `dft-raw/scripts/dft_ir_freeze_notice.py`; the emitted sidecar has top-level keys runId, task, producedBy, generatedAt, deliverable, sourceHashes, runOutputHashes, writeBoundary, verificationReports, fixtureAnchor — and I searched the whole run directory: `lateRulingsNotInIR` occurs in **no emitted artifact**, and the sidecar contains no `BD-05`, no `SetClamp` and no `provisional`. So either the writer did not run after the edit, or the field is dropped on emit.
